author: agent:claude-code
rationale: Record the 26.05 upgrade decision and the delta pager conflict it surfaced.

ops.text: NixOS hosts move to nixos-26.05; the macbook stays on 25.11-darwin
ops.why: Every NixOS and NixOS-WSL host (vgkraken, vgnixmini, vgsquid-azul, vgsquid-onyx, vgwsl2) follows nixos-26.05 with home-manager and NixOS-WSL release-26.05, as the nix.nixpkgs-release rule asks. The macbook is left on nixpkgs-25.11-darwin, at the user's request. stateVersion (the `version` in configurations) is not an upgrade knob: it stays at each host's install release (25.11), except vgkraken, a fresh minimal install made just before its first build, which starts at 26.05 and so takes 26.05's home-manager defaults (neovim without ruby/python3 providers, zsh dotDir under XDG; nothing here uses either). Checked with nix/scripts/check-hosts.sh: every host evaluates; vgnixmini and the two vgsquid servers stay PENDING (no hardware-configuration.nix in git), so their system closures were not evaluated.

ops.title: home-manager 26.05's delta integration sets pager.diff/log/show itself
ops.body: programs.delta.enableGitIntegration now writes pager.{diff,log,show,blame} through lib.hm.git.diffPagerConfig, so the module's own pager block ("delta") conflicted with it (`programs.git.iniContent.pager.diff' has conflicting definition values) and every Linux host failed to evaluate. Lesson: let the delta integration own git's pager settings; don't set them by hand alongside it.
